topic: Is a 1440p monitor worth upgrading to from 1080p
title: Worth It? Upgrading To A 1440p Monitor #siliconverdict #pcgaming #worthit
description: A quick verdict on moving from a 1080p to a 1440p gaming monitor: what you get, what it costs, and who should buy.
pinned_comment: Buy or skip? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: A 1440p monitor looks sharper, but it also asks more of your graphics card.
Stay to the end, because the answer depends on one thing you own.
Here is what the upgrade actually gives you on the desk.
A 1440p screen draws roughly 78 percent more pixels than a 1080p one.
More pixels means your graphics card must work harder for every single frame.
So the price is more than the monitor itself, as you will see.
Sharpness keeps improving, but each step looks a little less dramatic than the last.
The deciding question is whether your graphics card has headroom to spare.
If your card has headroom, this is the upgrade that most players notice.
Test one game at 1440p before you commit your budget.
Follow for more tech. Will you buy it, or skip it?
